response.original_title: Berlioz: Symphonie fantastique / Mahler: Symphony No. 1 'Titan' - Saito Kinen Orchestra / Seiji Ozawa
response.overview: Seiji Ozawa conducts the Saito Kinen Orchestra in Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique, recorded at the 2007 Saito Kinen Festival, and Mahler's Symphony No. 1 'Titan,' recorded at the 2008 festival. The NHK Blu-ray presents both performances in high-definition video with 96 kHz/24-bit PCM sound.
